description: Allowed narrative language and hard-blocked phrasing for Urd Atlas Regime Briefs V1. Narrative output must be descriptive, daily, non-intraday, non-predictive, and non-advisory.
required_guardrail_sentence: Data cadence: daily, not intraday. This is descriptive regime context, not a prediction or recommendation.

headlines: {CHAIN} remained {LABEL}-dominant across the latest 7 published days.
{CHAIN} moved from {PREVIOUS_LABEL} into {LATEST_LABEL} during the latest published window.
{CHAIN} showed a mixed regime path across the latest 7 published days.
persistence: The latest {LABEL} label has persisted for {N} published days.
The latest {LABEL} label is a one-day observation within the 7-day window.
The latest regime is recent rather than long-established.
drivers: The change was primarily driven by {AXIS}.
confidence: Confidence strengthened across the latest 7 published days.
Confidence weakened across the latest 7 published days.
Confidence remained broadly stable across the latest 7 published days.
The latest label has lower confidence support than the dominant label earlier in the window.
cross_chain: The latest published data shows chain-level divergence rather than a uniform cross-chain regime.
The latest published data by chain shows chain-level divergence rather than a uniform cross-chain regime.
The strongest contrast is between {CHAIN_A} and {CHAIN_B}.
The latest published data shows mixed conditions across supported chains.
Across each chain's latest published 7-day window, the data shows mixed conditions across supported chains.
